evals.prompt: Inventory the tech stack. package.json says node 18, the Dockerfile is FROM node:16-alpine, and the GitHub Actions workflow uses node-version 20.
evals.expected_output: A tech-stack.md that records the languages, runtime, frameworks, tooling and CI, and flags the three-way Node version mismatch.
assertions: The document is written to docs/codebase-map/tech-stack.md
The Node version mismatch across the manifest, the Dockerfile, and the CI workflow is flagged explicitly
All three versions 18, 16, and 20 are named with their sources
The build and test commands are taken from the CI workflow
Each fact cites the file it came from

evals.expected_output: An inventory of languages, runtime, frameworks, package managers, tooling, and CI, each cited to a file.
assertions: Languages and their versions are listed
Build, test, and lint tooling is listed with the commands
Each fact cites its source file

evals.prompt: Tech stack for this monorepo. The web package is TypeScript and the ml package is Python.
evals.expected_output: An inventory that reports the stack per package rather than flattening the monorepo into one stack.
assertions: The document reports the stack per package rather than as a single unified stack
Both the TypeScript web package and the Python ml package are covered with their own tooling
The workspace or monorepo tool is identified
Each fact cites its source file
